source.content: ApexPages.IdeaStandardSetController controller = new ApexPages.IdeaStandardSetController(); controller.setPageSize(7); System.assertEquals(7, controller.getPageSize()); controller.setFilterId('Recent'); System.assertEquals('Recent', controller.getFilterId()); List<Object> selected = new List<Object>{new Idea(Title = 'Selected Idea')}; controller.setSelected(selected); System.assertEquals(1, controller.getSelected().size()); System.assertEquals('Selected Idea', ((Idea)controller.getSelected()[0]).Title);
